hook_text: My new feed never ends either

song.title: Infinite Stroll
song.style: English, cheerful folk march, accordion, snare drum, tuba, whistling, rousing group vocals, 112 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Swapped my thumb scroll for my feet
Every corner something sweet
No ads pop up beside the trees
Just a dog who wants to meet

[Chorus]
Infinite stroll, infinite stroll
No refresh, just let it roll
Left foot, right foot, out we go
Infinite stroll, infinite stroll

shots.prompt: A cheerful woman in a yellow raincoat marches out of a round green door onto a winding path, swinging her arms high, a small dog trotting behind her. The camera tracks backwards in front of her. Bright morning sun, grass green and sky blue.
A dog with floppy ears trots along a winding path through rolling hills, tail wagging, turning to look back at the camera. Low tracking shot. Golden morning light.
Two neighbours wave at each other over a garden fence covered in climbing beans as one walks past with a walking stick. Static medium shot. Warm sunlight, leafy greens.
A man stops on a small wooden bridge over a stream and leans on the rail, watching a duck paddle below, smiling. The camera slowly pushes in. Dappled afternoon light, soft blues and greens.

A cream t-shirt with a simple illustration of rolling green hills and a winding path shaped like an infinity loop hangs on a wooden hanger against a sunny cream wall, gently swaying in a breeze from an open window. Soft daylight, warm shadows. Static close-up.
Three friends walk side by side up a grassy hill toward a big round sun, their long shadows stretching behind them. Wide static shot. Late afternoon gold.
A girl hops across stepping stones in a shallow creek, arms out for balance, laughing. The camera tracks with her from the side. Bright clear light, sparkling water.
An old man sits on a bench under a big oak tree at a bend in the path and tips his hat to a passing cyclist. Static wide shot. Warm late light, soft greens.
A woman stands at the top of a hill with her arms wide as the path winds endlessly away below her into hazy hills under a peach sunset. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach, gold and lavender, calm.

caption: Traded the infinite scroll for the Infinite Stroll tee. Same endless feeling, way more trees.
